source: Readers cannot tell which manual version matches their device. The new cover will list supported model numbers. We have not tested whether readers find it faster.
expectations: Open with the matching problem and reader task.
Explain how the model list addresses it.
Conclude with the proposed benefit while retaining the untested status.
knownBadRewrite: The new cover solves manual selection for everyone.

source: Explain in two sentences why a sensor needs calibration: its measured output drifts over time, and calibration compares it with a reference.
expectations: Meet the two-sentence scope without three forced headings.
Connect drift, comparison, and the purpose of calibration.

source: In tests on model A, the guide reduced setup errors from 8 to 5 out of 20 attempts. Other models were not tested.
expectations: Retain model A, both counts, denominator, and untested other models.
knownBadRewrite: The guide eliminates setup errors on every model.
